beats.text: Three teams, three A.I. providers, three sets of keys, and one surprise bill nobody can explain.
Fix found: Lite L.L.M., one gateway for more than a hundred A.I. providers, with an M.I.T. licensed core.
Give each team its own key, with a budget and a rate limit.
Every request is logged with its cost, so you can see who spent what. And if a provider fails, it falls back to another model.
The catch: single sign-on past five users and audit logs need a paid licence.
And keys and budgets need a Postgres database.
What problem should we fix next?
